status.en: 17 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 31% more than the week before, most of them in Baghdad, Kirkuk and Erbil.
status.nb: 17 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 31 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Baghdad, Kirkuk og Erbil.

summary.en: Iranian drones have struck Kurdish opposition camps and bases in Iraq, while Iranian-backed militias accuse the US of violating Iraqi airspace and Baghdad probes suspected Israeli strikes. Iraq has responded by closing Iran border crossings and strengthening its frontier with Saudi Arabia amid protests over the closures. Kurdish groups and Iranian forces continue to exchange attacks, heightening regional tensions. The conflict caused 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Iranske droner har rammet kurdiske opposisjonsleirer og baser i Irak, mens iransk-støttede militsene anklager USA for å ha krenket irakisk luftrom og Bagdad undersøker mistenkte israelske angrep. Irak har svart ved å stenge grenseoverganger til Iran og styrke grensen mot Saudi-Arabia midt i protester mot stengningene. Kurdiske grupper og iranske styrker fortsetter å utveksle angrep, noe som øker spenningen i regionen. Konflikten forårsaket 396 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Iraqi conflict
background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
